_comment: Hero ability defs — Q/W/E/R per class. v2 foundation reads Mage (Blaise) only; Knight/Ranger ship in v2.1 per port spec Part 3. Mage values sourced VERBATIM from the React v1 repo: src/modules/village/hero/abilities/mage.ts (MAGE_ABILITIES). Field map: cd -> cooldown, mana -> manaCost, power -> damage, reach -> radius/range (strike/snare = acquire range, aoe/cleave/meteor = blast radius). The 'description' field is a concise 1-line effect blurb for the HUD ability-bar tooltip (WO-36 visual) — NOT canon React data; safe to re-author. Knight + Ranger sets are authored defensible placeholders — NOT yet in the React repo — and must be re-synced when v1 publishes data/abilities.json (port spec Part 8).

knight-skills._comment: FLAT pool of equippable Knight skill-tree abilities (WO-614 full solo re-spec: heal / regen(HoT) / dot / ranged / melee-signatures / control / big-defensive). Each carries a unique 'id' so HeroLoadout equips it into a W/E/R slot OR the assignable hot-swap bar via AbilityCatalog.FindById; the per-slot 'slot' key is the chooser's SUGGESTED slot only. Effects: strike / heal / snare / cleave / aoe / taunt PLUS WO-614 shapes dot (ranged strike + Burn status) / healOverTime (HP drip via HeroAbilities) / invuln (HeroHealth.ActivateInvuln) — all resolved by HeroAbilities.ResolveEffect. Extra tuning fields: dotDamage/dotSeconds (dot burn), seconds (healOverTime duration + invuln duration). Referenced by the SKILL nodes (knight.t*) in hero-talents.json via their 'abilityId'.
